summary.text: Trojan father of Demuchus, a valiant man and tall, whom Achilles struck upon the knee and thereafter smote with his great sword when the son of Peleus swept through the ranks in *Iliad* 20.

story.text: Achilles left Dryops where he fell, and stayed from fight Demuchus, Philetor's son, a valiant man and tall, striking him upon the knee with a cast of his spear; and thereafter he smote him with his great sword, and took away his life.
